figures.label: 圖一
figures.caption: 圖一：校門口的全班團體照
figures.description: 校門口掛著「畢業快樂」的紅布條，全班十八位同學穿著制服排成兩排拍團體照：後排十位同學站著，前排八位同學坐在椅子上，導師坐在前排正中間，大家都面向鏡頭微笑。右前方的攝影師站在三腳架上的相機旁，舉起一隻手示意大家看鏡頭。

questions.stem: 提示：高三畢業前，同學們常在校園各處拍照留念。請仔細看下面兩張圖片，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段比較圖一與圖二兩種畢業照有什麼不同；第二段寫出你自己和同學拍照留念的一次經驗，並說明你比較喜歡哪一種畢業照及原因。

1.explanation_zh: 這一題有三個要求：第一段比較兩種畢業照（圖一在校門口、全班十八位同學與導師排成兩排、正式；圖二在教室、四個好友自拍、輕鬆搞笑），要寫出差異而不是各描述一次；第二段寫一次自己和同學拍照留念的經驗，再說明比較喜歡哪一種畢業照與原因。兩種都可以選，理由要和經驗連起來。
evidence: 比較圖一與圖二兩種畢業照有什麼不同
說明你比較喜歡哪一種畢業照及原因
1.strategy_zh: 比較時可以從地點、人數、姿勢、氣氛四個方面對照，用 however、on the other hand 連接；第二段先寫拍照經驗，再表態並給理由，最後也可以承認另一種的優點。
hints: 第一段：In Picture 1, … In Picture 2, however, … 寫出地點、人數、氣氛的不同
第二段：Last …, my classmates and I took photos … 寫一次拍照經驗
用 I like … better because … 說明偏好，結尾回應題目

moves.zh: 比較圖一與圖二兩種畢業照有什麼不同

content.focus_zh: 第一段要比較兩張圖的地點、人數與氣氛（人數照圖寫：全班十八位同學與導師，對比四個好友）；第二段要有一次具體的拍照經驗，並說明比較喜歡哪一種畢業照與理由。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段用對比的轉承語把兩張圖放在一起比較；第二段的偏好要呼應第一段提到的差異，結尾回到畢業照的意義。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 圖片用現在進行式，經驗用過去式；suggest that 後面接原形動詞（everyone jump）；比較級 better than 要完整。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 畢業、制服、團體照、自拍等說法（graduation、uniform、class photo、selfie）要用對；避免一直重複 funny 和 happy。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

sentence_starters: Last ..., my classmates and I took photos ...

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The two pictures show two different kinds of graduation photos. In Picture 1, the whole class is posing in front of the school gate. Ten students are standing in the back row, and eight are sitting on chairs in front with their teacher in the middle. The students are all wearing their school uniforms and smiling politely at the camera, so the photo looks neat and formal. In Picture 2, however, only four close friends are taking a selfie in their classroom. One boy is wearing a pair of silly glasses, and a girl is making a heart with her hands. Another boy is pretending to write on the blackboard. Unlike the first photo, this one looks relaxed and full of fun.
Last semester, my classmates and I took photos together after our sports day. At first, we stood in a line and smiled, but the photos looked boring. Then my friend suggested that everyone jump at the same time. We tried five times, and finally we got a photo with all of us in the air. I like the relaxed kind of graduation photo better because it shows our real personalities. For example, when I look at that jumping photo, I can still hear our laughter. Still, a class photo is important, since it includes everyone. To sum up, I hope to take both kinds of photos before I graduate, but the playful ones will always be my favorites.

paragraphs.function_zh: 比較兩張圖：圖一全班在校門口排成兩排、正式，圖二好友在教室做搞笑動作、輕鬆

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
Both pictures capture the same moment, graduation, yet they tell two very different stories. Picture 1 is a traditional class photo taken at the school gate under a red banner: eighteen students in neat uniforms are arranged in two rows, ten standing at the back and eight seated in front, with their homeroom teacher in the center. Beside a camera on a tripod, a photographer is raising one hand to get everyone's attention, and every face wears the same polite smile. Picture 2, on the other hand, is pure chaos in the best sense. Squeezed in front of a blackboard covered with signatures, four close friends are taking a selfie. One boy is wearing giant novelty glasses and sticking out his tongue, a girl is forming a heart with her hands, and another boy is pretending to write on the board with a piece of chalk. Whereas the first photo records who was there, the second records what it felt like to be there.
Last spring, my friends and I tried to take both kinds of photos on our last day of eleventh grade. The formal one took almost twenty minutes, because someone always blinked or looked away just as the shutter clicked. After that, we crowded together for a quick selfie. Ironically, that spontaneous one took only a few seconds, but it has become the picture I treasure most. In it, my best friend is laughing so hard that her eyes have disappeared, and I am holding a paper sign with our class number on it. Admittedly, a formal class photo has its own value. Years from now, it will be the only record that includes every single classmate, even the quiet ones who seldom took part in our silly games. Nevertheless, I prefer the playful kind, since memories are made of feelings rather than neat rows. All in all, every graduating class should ideally take both, one for the yearbook and one for the heart.

top.comment_zh: 第一段比較地點（校門口紅布條／黑板前）、人數（十八位同學分兩排加導師／四個好友）與氣氛（一致的禮貌微笑／歡樂的混亂），用 on the other hand、Whereas 對照，並以 the first photo records who was there, the second records what it felt like to be there 點出差異；第二段同一天先拍正式照、再拍自拍的經驗具體，讓步承認團體照能留下每位同學後表態偏好搞笑照，理由呼應第一段，結尾回到畢業照的意義。未見語言錯誤，用字精準。小地方：Last spring 和 last day of eleventh grade（學年最後一天多在六月底）時間略不一致；Picture 1 is a traditional class photo 其實圖中畫的是拍照現場，都不影響理解，不扣分。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段比較地點（校門口／教室）、人數（後排十人、前排八人加導師／四個好友）與氣氛（neat and formal／relaxed and full of fun），用 however、Unlike 轉承；第二段運動會後全班跳起來拍照的經驗具體，說明偏好輕鬆照片的理由並舉例，也承認團體照的重要，結尾表態。suggested that everyone jump 用法正確，未見語言錯誤；句型與字彙正確但較平實，四項都給 4。

top.comment_zh: 第一段從地點、人數（十八位同學分兩排、四位好友）、人物動作到氣氛都做了對比，並以 Whereas 句收束差異；第二段有正式合照與自拍兩種照片的經驗、讓步與自己的立場，結尾回到畢業照的意義。轉承語自然，句型多變，用字生動精準（novelty glasses、spontaneous、treasure），無文法與拼字錯誤。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段由地點（校門口對教室）、人數（全班對四位好友）與氣氛（正式對輕鬆）做比較，切題且與圖相符；第二段有運動會後跳起來拍照的經驗、偏好與理由，並承認班級合照的重要。suggested that everyone jump 的用法正確。結構清楚、沒有錯誤，但句型偏簡單，photo、looks 等字重複，用字平實。
